diffmapVersion.description: The package version that built the payload.

repo.description: The origin remote's repository name, or the workspace root's directory name. Absent when unknown.

branch.description: The checked-out branch. Absent when HEAD is detached.

file.description: File name, such as 02-write-through.md. The cover is README.md.

slug.description: File name without its number, such as write-through. Empty for the cover.

changes.description: Opaque snapshot per commit. Pass it through unread; its contents change without a schemaVersion bump.

files.description: Path to contents of each file an excerpt reads.
